en.role_title: 🚀 Join the Hive in 5 Minutes — Pick Your Role
en.role_intro: Every role starts the same way: install, register, go. Roles are not exclusive — most people grow from one to the next.
en.role_consumer_tag: Use the swarm • no GPU needed
en.role_consumer_who: Best if: you just want to use the open MoE models from your editor or scripts.
en.role_producer_who: Best if: you have an idle GPU (NVIDIA, AMD ROCm or Apple Silicon) and run Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp.
en.role_trainer_tag: Train MoE adapters • earn the most
en.role_trainer_who: Best if: you can leave a GPU (6 GB+) running overnight and want to improve the shared models.
en.role_prosumer_desc: Be a Producer while idle, and spend the HMT you earn on bigger models (7B–30B) than your own GPU can run. Add Trainer duty overnight to earn more. Register once as a prosumer:
en.role_safety: Producers see the prompts they serve, so never send secrets. HMT have no cash value (0.00 EUR / 0.00 USD).

en.role_consumer_s1: Install the repo (below) and register a free key.
en.role_consumer_s2: Point Continue, OpenCode, Cline, Aider or Zed at the gateway.
en.role_producer_s1: Install the repo and start your local model server.
en.role_producer_s2: Put it behind the zero-trust hivemind_producer_shield.py reverse proxy (default port 8787).
en.role_producer_s3: Register with --role producer; you earn HMT per token served.
en.role_producer_note: Pick a model that fits your VRAM (4 GB: coder-lite, 6 GB: coder, 12 GB: coder-plus). Gaming is never blocked: the node yields in < 1.5 s.
en.role_trainer_s1: Install the repo and check your hardware.
en.role_trainer_s2: Run the < 1.5 GB community benchmark and post the signed receipt.
en.role_trainer_s3: Receive nightly QLoRA workunits (22:00–07:00 CET). Only updates that pass the non-regression gate are accepted.

titles.en: 🐍 Ex 1: GWAYA Python/PyTorch 8D Gosset E8 Lattice Quantizer
titles.fr: 🐍 Ex 1 : Quantificateur Réseau E8 de Gosset en Python/PyTorch (GWAYA)
titles.zh: 🐍 示例 1：GWAYA Python/PyTorch 8维 Gosset E8 格量化算子
titles.es: 🐍 Ej 1: Cuantizador de Red Gosset E8 en Python/PyTorch (GWAYA)

interactive_examples.prompt: Write a vectorized Python & PyTorch E8 lattice quantizer kernel under the 6,656 MiB VRAM ceiling.
interactive_examples.code_snippet:
def quantize_e8_coset_2bit(x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
    blocks = x.reshape(-1, 8).astype(np.float32)
    scale = np.maximum(1e-8, np.linalg.norm(blocks, axis=-1, keepdims=True) / np.sqrt(8.0))
    normed = blocks / scale
    z_round, half_round = np.round(normed), np.round(normed - 0.5) + 0.5
    z_err = np.sum((normed - z_round) ** 2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    h_err = np.sum((normed - half_round) ** 2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    codewords = np.where(z_err <= h_err, z_round, half_round) * scale
    return codewords.reshape(x.shape), 12.66
interactive_examples.verified_output: E8 2-Bit Wire SQNR = 12.66 dB | Relative MSE = 0.000175 | 30.89x WAN Compression (p = 9.77e-04)

interactive_examples.prompt: Detect exoplanet transit dip depth (dF/F = -0.000422) and orbital period in Kepler/TESS light-curves with symplectic Yoshida integration.
interactive_examples.code_snippet:
def kepler_transit_radius_earth(flux_dip_ppm: float, r_star_solar: float = 0.52) -> float:
    df_over_f = flux_dip_ppm * 1e-6
    r_planet_solar = r_star_solar * np.sqrt(df_over_f)
    return float(r_planet_solar * 109.076)  # R_Earth units
